items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: By this time Booker Pittman and Ben Webster had joined Jap Allen

ctx.x: And of course this is the time that Ben Webster is with Jap Allen, and Basie and all of 'em is in the Eblon Theater, and we drinking this beer, and this meddled whiskey together, and hanging out all together, and all the musicians -- Booker Pittman is blowing the bell out of the saxaphone by this time. And now he's working with Basie on 12th Street with a little four-piece group, and he's blowing everybody out that coming near in there.

Ben Webster is blowing all kind of tenor saxophone now, and he -- with Jap Allen, Clyde Hart tried hard -- is sitting by the record player putting nickles in it and writing all of McKinney's Cotton and music players, copping solos and everything, and making arrangements for Jap Allen. By this time Booker Pittman and Ben Webster had joined Jap Allen, and finally they played a battle of music with McKenny's Cottonpickers at
15 Paseo Hall. [Paseo Hall - on 15th at Paseo]
